//: Copy to <your-repo>/.claude/audit.config.json and edit. EVERY key is optional; omit any to take the default. This is Layer 1 of the plugin's extensibility model — no code editing needed. Prefer a UI? Run /audit:panel to edit this file (schema-validated) + wire composition visually.
//gitRoot: Path of the git repo root relative to this project dir. Default '.' (project dir IS the git root). Set to e.g. 'test' when git/the workspace lives in a subdirectory; keep in sync with the manifest's meta.gitRoot.
//enforce: Force the plan-first gate to DENY even with no manifest. Default false, which grades the gate on evidence: observe (no manifest) -> warn (manifest, nothing running) -> deny (a phase is in_progress). Set true for the pre-0.20 always-on behaviour. The secret guards are never graded.

secretPatterns.//: Extra regexes (added to the built-in env/credentials/key/cert set) matched against target paths/commands.

guardEdits.//: tokenVars: identifier names treated as auth tokens for the logging ban; your list REPLACES the three defaults rather than adding to them. customRules: project-specific banned patterns, each fires when pathPrefix occurs ANYWHERE in the edited path (a substring match, despite the name), so 'src/realtime/' also covers packages/web/src/realtime/.

customRules.//: ILLUSTRATIVE example: forbid removeAllListeners() in a realtime/subscription layer (a common footgun that nukes sibling listeners). Replace path + pattern with your own, or leave customRules empty ([]).
customRules.message: removeAllListeners() removes OTHER subscribers' listeners. Track this instance's listener in a ref and remove only it.

bashWriteCheck.//: PostToolUse git-status diff check (guard-bash-writes.py): warns — non-blocking — when a shell command modifies a source file no in_progress task covers. Needs a git repo; silent otherwise.

tddReminder.//: Non-blocking TDD nudge (remind-tdd.py): warns Claude when a source file changes and no test file was touched this session. Never blocks. Set enabled:false to turn off. inProgressPolicy: skip-gate-only (default) | skip-all | warn-always — controls whether files covered by an in_progress manifest task are exempt.

//usage: Token metering (meter-usage.py + /audit:usage). Rates are USD per MILLION tokens and live here on purpose: a price change is a one-line edit in your repo, not a plugin release. Cost is priced and stored when a row is written, so editing this table never rewrites history. Only list the models you actually run - anything unlisted resolves by longest name prefix, then '_default'. authorMode: email|name|hash|none. The ledger records counts, model ids, timestamps, branch and author - never prompt content.

usage.//bands: Absolute cost bands for typical/high/outlier. Left null, the bands calibrate from this project's own completed tasks (median and p90), which needs no guess to mean something. Set BOTH to band by a budget instead - highUSD must be > 0 and <= outlierUSD, and any other pair is ignored in favour of the relative basis.
